# Code Anchors: Provenance Reference

- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.ts` — the provenance pattern accepting a bare issue reference, a qualified owner-and-repository reference, or the bootstrap and manual markers.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the drain's provenance resolution: the qualified form as the workspace-hub default, the bare form for a single-repo home repo.
- `components/commands/nxs.fix.md` — reads a single reference in this grammar, resolves it against either an issue or a pull request without distinguishing them, and adds only the qualification.
